channel.title: DbDo Walkthroughs
channel.description: Short simulated walks through DbDo, using the JobTrail job search database that ships with it. Each one is about three minutes, with something to try at the end.
channel.itunes:author: Jamal Mazrui

item.title: 00 - Overview and Table of Contents
item.description: DbDo is installed and your reader is running. Nothing else is needed. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0-00-overview-and-table-of-contents

item.title: 01 - Install and Launch
item.description: The installer is downloaded, and your reader is running. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0a-01-install-and-launch

item.title: 02 - User Interface Concepts
item.description: DbDo is open with any database. Nothing needs pressing in this walk; it is listened to. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0b-02-user-interface-concepts

item.description: DbDo is open with any database. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0c-03-key-patterns

item.title: 04 - Open and Move Through a Database

item.description: JobTrail is open on the jobs table. This morning I found a support analyst opening at Widget Works. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0e-05-add-inspect-and-edit-records
